quarterly_data.quarter: SoftBank press release: Completion of Acquisition of DigitalBridge (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SoftBank Group completed on September 30, 2026 (U.S. time) the acquisition of all outstanding common stock of DigitalBridge Group, Inc., described by SoftBank as 'a leading global alternative asset manager dedicated to investing in digital infrastructure'. DigitalBridge has become a controlled subsidiary of SBG and will continue to operate as a separately managed platform; its financial position and results will be included in SBG's consolidated financial statements from the date of acquisition.
